digest.description: Every Monday morning, owners and admins get an e-mail with what is overdue and what comes due within the "soon" period set under Due dates. When nothing needs attention, no e-mail is sent.

scanLocation.description: When a label is scanned during an inspection, the phone's location is recorded and the protocol says whether it matches the building. Only at the moment of a scan, never continuously. Technicians are told so in the app.

import.description: Upload customers, buildings and devices from your Excel or CSV. One row is one device with its customer and building.

file.tip1: Only Customer and Building are required. A row without device details adds just the customer and building.
file.tip2: Existing customers (by company ID or name), buildings and locations are reused. A device whose serial number is already in the building is skipped. Devices without a serial number are added again on every import.
file.tip3: Without a device type, Fire extinguisher is used. A Quantity column adds several units at once.

reopen.title: Correct a completed inspection
reopen.description: The inspection reopens as in progress, and the devices' due dates from it don't count until the correction is completed. Completing it again creates a new report version; the current one stays saved.
reopen.reasonPlaceholder: What is being corrected and why
reopen.done: The inspection is reopened for a correction.
reopen.openBody: Correct what's needed and complete the inspection again. A new report version with the same number is created; the original stays saved. The inspection date and technician stay from the original inspection.

summary.title: Summary report
summary.filtersLabel: Narrow the summary to a customer, building or period

locationFilter.label: Location at scanning

defects.title: Defects
defects.emptyBody: Defects come from failed items in inspections, or you report them on a device.
defects.noResultsBody: Try other text or a label number, or clear the filters.

form.deviceNotFound: You have no device with this label number.

detail.resolveNotePlaceholder: E.g. seal replaced, extinguisher sent for repair…

overall.failed: {count, plural, one {# device failed} other {# devices failed}}.

email.body: {organization} is sending you the inspection report for {site} from {date}. The report is attached to this e-mail.
email.replyHint: You can reply to this e-mail; {organization} will receive your reply.

card.title: Report

card.emailDisabled: Sending e-mails isn't set up yet. Download the report and send it yourself.
card.missingTitle: The report has no PDF yet

digest.subject: {organization}: {overdue} overdue, {upcoming} due within {days} days
digest.heading: Due dates as of {date}

digest.footnote: Owners and admins of {organization} get this summary every Monday morning. You can turn it off under Weekly summary in Settings.

search.label: Search
search.hint: Search by name, address, company ID, serial number, label number (12), defect (D-12) or report (2026-0001).

guide.title: Getting started

company.title: Add your company details and logo

customer.title: Add your first customer
customer.body: The company or manager you do inspections for. Have a list in Excel? Import it with buildings and devices.

site.title: Add a building
site.body: Its address and access notes for the technician.

device.title: Add devices
device.body: The extinguishers in the building, one by one or in bulk.

label.title: Print labels
label.body: A QR label on a device opens its check on the phone.

guide.sampleTitle: Want to try the app first?
guide.sampleBody: We'll add a sample customer with two buildings, devices due at different times and a defect. Try an inspection and a report on them, then remove it all with one button.
guide.sampleRemoveBody: This removes the sample customer, its buildings and devices and everything you tried on them: inspections, reports, defects and photos. Your real data isn't touched.

pwa.description: Fire safety equipment inspections: records, QR labels, checks on the phone, reports and due dates.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: The page couldn't be shown. Please try again. If it keeps happening, let us know and quote the code below.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Inspections saved in this phone work without a signal. What you do is sent as soon as there's a connection.
offline.none: No inspection is saved in this phone. An inspection is saved by itself when you open it with a connection.
offline.waiting: {count, plural, one {# change waits} other {# changes wait}} to be sent

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.overdueDevices: {count, plural, one {# device is past its inspection date} other {# devices are past their inspection date}}
calendar.missedPlans: {count, plural, one {# planned inspection this month wasn't started} other {# planned inspections this month weren't started}}
calendar.devicesDue: {count, plural, one {# device due} other {# devices due}}
calendar.dayCounts: {plans, plural, =0 {no planned inspection} one {# planned inspection} other {# planned inspections}}, {devices, plural, =0 {no device due} one {# device due} other {# devices due}}
calendar.emptyMonth: Nothing is planned this month and no device is due for inspection.

day.noPlans: Nothing is planned for this day.
day.noDue: No device is due for inspection on this day.

plan.title: Plan an inspection
plan.noteHint: Optional, e.g. an agreed time or a contact on site.

workload.hint: Planned inspections in the next {weeks} weeks and the number of active devices in their buildings.

scanLocation.introText: When you scan a label, the app records the phone's location and its accuracy. The protocol then says for each device whether the location matches the building. The location is recorded only at the moment of a scan, never continuously, and it never limits the check.
scanLocation.introPermission: The phone will now ask for permission to use its location. If you don't allow it, the check goes on all the same and the protocol says “location not determined”.
scanLocation.noteHint: Shown in the protocol next to the device.
scanLocation.noteOffline: The explanation can be saved only with a signal.
scanLocation.noSitePoint: The building has no coordinates, so scan locations can't be compared.
scanLocation.summary: The location at scanning matched the building for {matches} of {total} devices.

siteMap.title: Building map
siteMap.mapLabel: Map of buildings with their inspection state

status.warning: Due soon, never inspected or a defect

counts.critical: {count, plural, one {# critical defect} other {# critical defects}}

siteMap.unlocatedHint: Buildings without coordinates aren't on the map. Add them in the building's form.
siteMap.emptyNoSites: The company has no buildings yet. Add a customer and their buildings.
siteMap.emptyNoPoints: No building has coordinates yet. Add them to the buildings under Without a location.

protocolTemplates.title: Protocol templates
protocolTemplates.readOnly: Protocol templates are edited by the owner and administrators. Technicians use them.
protocolTemplates.empty: The company has no protocol template yet.

create.title: New protocol template
create.name: Template name
create.fromHint: The template is created as a draft. Protocols follow it only once it is published.
create.importTitle: Import a template from a file
create.importExplain: A JSON file exported from SparxDeck (from another company, say). The template is checked again before it is stored and arrives as a draft; its own logo is converted again.
create.importNameHint: Without one, the name in the file is used.

preview.failed: The preview could not be drawn. Try the change again.
preview.label: Protocol preview

editor.removed: Block removed. Undo brings it back.

save.failed: The draft could not be saved.

editor.discardDescription: Changes that aren't published are deleted and the template goes back to its published version. Issued protocols don't change.
editor.mobileNotice: The layout of blocks is edited on a computer. On a phone you can check the preview and edit the texts.

issue.headerMissing: A protocol needs the header with the protocol number and the company's details.
issue.headerHidden: The header with the protocol number and the company's details can't be hidden.
issue.headerTwice: A protocol can have the header only once.
issue.invalid: {block}: a value is out of range
issue.headerCondition: The header with the protocol number and the company's details always shows; it can't have a condition.
issue.accentContrast: The company colour is hard to read on white paper. Choose a darker one.
issue.logoMissing: The header should have its own logo, but none is uploaded.

editor.shortcuts: Shortcuts: Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo, Ctrl+S save, Alt+arrow moves the selected block, Esc clears the selection. Move a block also by dragging its handle, or with the keyboard: space on the handle, arrows, space.
editor.name: Template name

blocks.label: Order of blocks
blocks.dragInstructions: Press space to pick up a block, arrows to move it, space to drop it, Escape to cancel.

properties.outOfRangeWhole: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
properties.title: Heading
properties.titleHint: Empty = the default heading in the protocol's language.
properties.columnsHint: The number of a column is its share of the line; columns always fill the full width.
properties.headerLocked: The protocol number and the company's name are always in the header. The header can't be removed or hidden.
properties.emptyHint: Details the customer or building doesn't have are left out of the protocol.
properties.devicesSummary: Sentence with the counts above the table
properties.devicesDetails: Findings and notes under each device
properties.columnsWithScan: Own columns when the protocol reports the scan location
properties.columnsWithScanHint: When the company records scan locations, a "Scan location" column is added at the end and the widths are recalculated.
properties.whenEmpty: When the inspection finds no defects

whenEmptyOption.text: Say that no defects were found

properties.textHint: Variables are filled in from the inspection. The company writes its own legal wording and notices; the app doesn't make them up.
properties.signatureCustomerHint: The customer's field shows their finger signature if they gave one when the inspection was completed.
properties.signatureHint: Line "Name, signature and date" under the fields
properties.notesHint: The note the technician wrote when completing the inspection. Without a note the block is left out.
properties.dividerHint: A horizontal line across the full width.
properties.pageBreakHint: The next block starts on a new page.
properties.unreadable: The stored template couldn't be read; the editor starts from the default protocol.
properties.logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG up to 2 MB. An SVG is cleaned of scripts and stored as a picture.

page.footerOrganizationHint: The footer text is changed in Settings → Protocols.
page.pageNumbers: Protocol and page number on every page
page.languageHint: The protocol's own words (headings, results, dates) in this language. The template's own texts aren't translated.
page.fontHint: Fonts under the open OFL licence, embedded in the PDF.
page.accentOn: Headings, the header's rule and table heads in the company colour
page.accentLow: The colour is hard to read on white paper (contrast {ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 needed). Choose a darker one.
page.accentHint: Results stay words, not colours: the protocol reads the same from a black-and-white printer.

sample.label: Label legible
sample.notes: A sample note of the technician on the inspection.

richText.linkInvalid: A link must start with https:// or mailto:.

options.hasDefects: Only when the inspection found defects
options.noDefects: Only when the inspection found no defects
options.deviceType: Only when the inspection has a device type
options.notEmpty: Only when a detail is filled in

conditions.noDeviceTypes: The company has no device types yet.

row.archiveDescription: New protocols won't use it and its assignments to customers and device types are removed. Issued protocols don't change. It can be restored.

publish.title: Publish the template
publish.blocked: The template can't be published yet. Fix:
publish.explain: The draft is stored as a new version. New protocols use it at once; issued protocols keep the version they were made with.
publish.noteHint: A short note for the version history (required).

history.title: Template history
history.noVersions: The template has no published version yet.

kinds.restored: {version, plural, =0 {Restored from the archive} other {Version # restored as the draft}}

history.restoreDescription: The version's content goes into the draft. Protocols change only once it is published again.
history.restoreReplaces: The version's content replaces the draft in progress. Protocols change only once it is published again.

assign.needsPublished: Only a published template can be assigned.
assign.title: Who the template is for
assign.explain: A protocol uses its customer's template, else its device type's (when the inspection is all one type), else the company's default.
assign.noCustomers: The company has no customers yet.
assign.deviceTypesHint: Applies to inspections with devices of this type only.

point.hint: Latitude and longitude. Copy them from a map application, or use the phone's location.

routes.title: Routes
routes.straightLine: Distances are in a straight line, without roads or traffic. This is not navigation.
routes.empty: No routes yet. Create the first one and add buildings to it.

edit.title: Edit the route
edit.hint: The visits in the calendar move with the route.

delete.title: Delete the route?
delete.description: The route is deleted, with the calendar visits created with it. Inspections already done stay.

summary.label: Route summary
summary.noPoints: The distance is computed once the buildings on the route have a location.

start.title: Start point
start.label: Where the route starts
start.setCompany: The company's seat is set in Settings.
start.setHome: Everyone sets their home in their account.

options.title: Ordering
options.sortedSame: The app found no shorter order.
options.sortHint: Nearest neighbour, then 2-opt improvement, in a straight line.
options.unlocated: Buildings without a location stay at the end; place them by hand.

nearby.none: Nothing is due within {distance} of the stops.

today.offline: No signal, the plan is saved in the phone.
